From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jason Li <jason.li@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + Mutual Action Plan (next steps)

Hi Jason —

Great to meet you and the ACME eval team today. Quick recap and the Mutual Action Plan attached:

What we covered:
- Goals: validate inference latency at your 2k qps baseline and confirm integration with your data pipeline (S3 -> Redwood ingest).
- Success criteria: P50 < 120ms, throughputs of 2k qps sustained in dedicated capacity, and no PII leakage in outputs.
- Timeline: 3-week evaluation window with a parallel security review.

Mutual Action Plan (attached) — please confirm owners and target dates on the right-hand column. My suggested owners/dates are in red:
- Week 0: kickoff + access (Jason / ACME infra) — target 2026-04-17
- Week 1: ingest + baseline test (ACME infra + Dylan) — target 2026-04-24
- Week 2: performance tuning (Redwood SE + ACME) — target 2026-05-01
- Week 3: final validation + exec sync — target 2026-05-08

Next steps / asks:
1) Can you confirm who on your side will own each line in the MAP (names & emails)?
2) Are the suggested dates realistic or should we shift the window?
3) Any blockers on the security questionnaire — I attached the eval template as well.

If helpful, Dylan can run the baseline tests once you provide S3 credentials and a small sample dataset.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

Hi Jason —

Just wanted to bump this in case it got buried. Attached MAP and suggested dates above — would love to lock owners so Dylan can schedule a kickoff lab.

Quick options if helpful:
- Kickoff this Thu 2026-04-15 at 10am PT (30–45m)
- Kickoff next Tue 2026-04-20 at 11am PT

If now isn't the right time, a one-line update on priority/timing is totally fine — we can adjust.

Thanks,
Marissa

Subject: Quick follow-up — confirm MAP owners/dates?

Hi Jason —

Following up again on the MAP I sent 4/10. I know these evaluation windows can move — if the proposed week-of-4/17 start is too soon, can you tell me:

1) Is the evaluation still a priority for Q2? (yes/no)
2) Who should I expect to own the infra access and baseline tests on your side?
3) Any missing compliance docs we should surface before kickoff?

If helpful, I can send an updated version with your owners pre-filled — just point me at the names/emails and I’ll update.

If I don’t hear back by EOD Tue we’ll assume you want to pause and I’ll check back in mid-May — but happy to accelerate if you can confirm dates.

Best,
Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Recap + Mutual Action Plan (next steps) — suggested next steps if no reply

Rishi / Dylan — forwarding the thread. No response from Acme yet. My plan if we don’t get confirmation by Tue:
- Send one final short note offering a QA kickoff slot in mid-May and propose a 30-day hold if they need more time.
- If still no response after that, mark as nurture in HubSpot and set a reminder for 2026-05-18.

If you think we should try a different angle (exec intro / bring in Solutions Eng), I’m happy to loop them in. Otherwise I’ll send the final soft close Tue morning.

Thanks,
Marissa
